title: Sayaw sa Sala
caption: Groovy Filipino neo-soul and R&B love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, playful young male tenor with an easy falsetto in the chorus, stacked harmonies answering the lead. A melodic, bouncing electric bass line up front, warm Rhodes electric piano with jazzy chords, clean funk guitar plucks, a relaxed head-nodding drum groove with a tight snare and handclaps, soft horn pads. Sweet, flirtatious, slow dancing with a girl in the living room. Modern, polished, warm production.
lyrics:
